hypothesis: The highest-ranked preserved non-seed zero-circle candidates from the completed circle search may avoid the five violations shared by the pinned upstream seeds and produce a full taxi result below 3.
rationale: The prior released-cache run completed 686 exact circle candidates, but deterministic tie-breaking selected two known pinned seeds among tied zero-circle candidates. Its artifact preserves additional tied zero-circle candidates. Excluding every pinned seed and the zero vector tests the next available candidates without rerunning the circle search or using a fixed-edge proxy.
expected_information_gain: Determines whether the preserved non-seed portion of the completed circle search contains a target-relevant taxi candidate and closes or promotes this exact shortlist path.
method: Load the prior circle-to-taxi artifact and locked upstream search source. Exclude the zero vector and every vector in the source's SEED_VECTORS set. Select the highest-ranked two remaining candidates from the preserved circle_search.best list and evaluate each sequentially with the pinned stage-D full taxi path using eight bounded streaming potential workers. Do not rebuild the circle cache, alter the evaluator, alter metric data, or screen on a proxy. Independently reproduce any result below 3 with the unmodified evaluator entrypoint.
metric: primary: exact full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k; input ranking: exact complete circle_k4_m6 violations_k
metric_relation_to_true_objective: Only a completed full taxi result below 3 reaches the frozen finite target. The prior circle score is used only to select preserved candidates and cannot establish target progress.

configuration.excluded_vectors: zero plus all five pinned SEED_VECTORS
configuration.evaluator: pinned stage-D logic; independent evaluator required for any target result

compute_budget.cpu: one parent plus eight bounded streaming potential workers per sequential finalist
compute_budget.memory_intent: stream node potentials; no circle B cache

kill_condition: Stop at the first full result below 3, after two full finalists, at 1600 seconds, or at a precise runtime failure. Do not infer target progress from circle-only scores or from an incomplete taxi result.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict target progress only if a full non-seed finalist scores below 3

previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: a non-seed finalist must improve on 5 to be finite movement and must score below 3 to reach target

interpretation: The exact taxi gate evaluated the two highest-ranked preserved non-seed zero-circle candidates on all 7,000,602 inequalities. Both returned 54 violations, compared with 5 for the pinned upstream seed and the frozen reported best of 3. The target was not reached and no candidate was promoted.
what_was_learned: Excluding the five pinned seeds corrected the provenance tie-break, but the next two zero-circle candidates were globally poor: each introduced 54 taxi violations. Complete-circle zero score is not a useful selector for this preserved mutation stream, and further exact gates from the same top-20 artifact have low expected value.
recommended_next_action: Close the preserved circle-shortlist family under the current evaluator. Reallocate only to a materially different global taxi search or a more capable runtime; do not spend further budget on the same circle-zero selector.
repetition_justification: This does not repeat the prior 600-second circle search or its seed-inclusive full gate. It consumes preserved candidates from that artifact and changes only the provenance-safe shortlist rule; the full taxi evaluator and metric remain unchanged.
